name: Gibomai ~Haitoku no Kyouen~
source:
A renowned painter died of heart disease while he was married to Megumi, a woman much younger than he was. His son, Kyosuke, never liked that union and wanted Megumi out of the house. Therefore Megumi proposes that Kyosuke can do anything he wants with her daughter Yuna, Kyosuke's sister-in-law, if he allows them to stay. Naturaly, Kyosuke accepts.

[Edited from [url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=anime&aid=1604]AniDB[/url]]
translation:
一位著名画家在与比他年轻得多的惠美结婚时因心脏病去世。他的儿子恭介从来不喜欢这种结合，并希望惠离开家。因此，惠提议恭介可以对恭介的嫂子女儿由奈做任何他想做的事，只要他允许他们留下来。恭介自然答应了。

[编辑自[url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=anime&aid=1604]AniDB[/url]]
